📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #122 (family total; this monitor's own count folded into the shared entry).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@crm-experience` / `#team-crm`)
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor ID in the 5-sibling family) → pull DD metric over a multi-hour window (expect brief dip below floor, not a real gap) → confirm 0 `status:error` logs → check sibling 5xx/latency monitor → if fire is still open after ~1h or a sibling co-fires, escalate.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status: monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed

Source alerts (1 total, degraded mode — no live Slack message observed):
  • DD monitor 302057011: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011
  • DD logs (0 hits, status:error window): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%20env%3Aprod%20status%3Aerror&from_ts=1786671000000&to_ts=1786677300000&live=false
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1786671000&end=1786677300
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this KB, not elasticsearch
  • This-window concentration: sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:runtime-core-subscriber} dipped repeatedly below the 2msg/s/15m floor 01:52-02:10Z then self-recovered by 02:47:31Z; 0 error logs

Note: KB entry's match.channels was scoped to alert-system/swat only; added alert-runtime-monitoring (this monitor's confirmed real DD notify target) so future cycles match directly.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #660 in this entry's history (chronic, fix_status: chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `unmapped` — spans method-ui frontend + gateway-routed backend, no single ownership.md row covers it
Playbook: light-touch DD logs re-check of the monitor's own 5-min per-account rollup; if no single account reproduces the >40 threshold, mechanism stays unconfirmed but the shared-endpoint shape (syncutil/syncwidget across many accounts) is consistent with prior occurrences.
Open Jira: n/a

🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 12)
Channel: alert-system  •  bug-type guess: env  •  alerts in group: 1 (degraded mode — no live Slack message; DD-scan-diff synthetic. See related same-window fires: monitors 303750154, 301582337, 302056407 on #alert-runtime-monitoring, investigated separately, confirmed downstream symptoms of this same event)
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin, Vertical App Experience, CRM Experience`

Symptoms:
  - Gateway 5xx spike: 223 errors in a 70s burst (peak 55/10s) at 14:09:00-14:10:10Z UTC
  - ms-tags-api AND method-mobile-notifications-api p95 latency both flatlined at ~100s (HttpClient timeout ceiling) for the identical 60s window
  - runtime-core-api logged 54 "Request timed out after 100s" errors calling ms-preferences-api's featureflags endpoint across >=10 accounts — but ms-preferences-api's own p95 metric stayed healthy throughout, ruling out that service's own code
  - Gateway Warning-level logs show 500s on multiple unrelated virtual apps (tags, scheduler, authservice) in the same window — diffuse, not one backend's bug

Trace IDs: n/a (no single trace pulled — pattern established via cross-service metric + ES aggregate correlation, see investigation doc)
Likely cause: brief (~70s) stall in the shared microservices.method.int reverse-proxy/network hop — every downstream virtual app behind it hung simultaneously while the named backend (ms-preferences-api) stayed healthy on its own metrics
Suggested next action: file defect — Admin team to check nginx/IIS-layer health for microservices.method.int around 2026-08-14T14:09:00-14:10:10Z UTC; monitor for recurrence via new KB entry ki-2026-08-14-microservices-method-int-100s-timeout-cascade

Source alerts (1 total):
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/70171778  (alert-system, 14:16 UTC last_triggered — actual burst 14:09-14:10 UTC)

Evidence:
  • DD monitors: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/70171778 — "Unexpected number of 5XX errors" (OK, self-recovered)
  • DD metric (5xx by service): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request.errors&exp_scope=env%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1786716098&end=1786717118
  • DD metric (ms-tags-api p95, flat ~100s plateau): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Ams-tags-api&exp_agg=p95&start=1786716098&end=1786717118
  • DD logs (gateway errors): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Agateway%20status%3Aerror&from_ts=1786716098000&to_ts=1786717118000&live=false
  • Kibana (runtime-core-api timeout signature, 54 hits): https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-08-14T14:09:00Z',to:'2026-08-14T14:10:20Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'level.keyword:Error%20AND%20fields.dd_service.keyword:runtime-core-api%20AND%20message:%22Request%20timed%20out%20after%20100s%22'))

Note: degraded-mode DD-scan-diff cycle (no Slack MCP this session) — no live Slack alert text/permalinks available. Full investigation: docs/investigations/2026-08-14-0a4acd1fcc2190eb.md

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-ms-scheduler-api-seriesid-negative-recordid`
This is occurrence #148 in this entry's history.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@crm-experience` / `#team-crm`)
Playbook: Confirmed code-level missing-guard bug in SeriesDataProvider.GetSeriesIdAsync (Scheduler.Core) — no guard against the sentinel recordId=-1 before SqlDataReader.GetValue(). Not account-specific (15+ distinct accounts to date). File/bump a defect for CRM Experience rather than re-diagnosing from scratch each cycle.
Open Jira: n/a
